requirements.ruleText: Be under age 25, in good health, and provide a Guardian Authorization Letter if under age 18.
Hold and submit a valid foreign ordinary passport; the submitted passport must remain valid at least six months beyond the intended enrollment date.

references.locator: page 2, Eligibility and Application Documents item 8

requirements.ruleText: Submit notarized Chinese- or English-language senior high-school graduation evidence; final-year students may apply with an expected-graduation certificate but must provide the official diploma before September 1, 2026.

references.locator: page 2, Eligibility item 3 and Application Documents item 2

requirements.ruleText: Submit notarized high-school academic transcripts with courses, scores, and grading-system explanation, plus the applicable home-country or international standardized-examination transcript.
HSK Level 4 or equivalent. Some named Chinese-language routes may exempt the CSCA Chinese subject with a valid HSK Level 4 report.

references.locator: page 2, Language and Application Documents item 4

requirements.ruleText: Submit CSCA results for STEM Chinese, Mathematics, Chemistry.

references.locator: official 2026 program and CSCA subject table

requirements.ruleText: Submit one recommendation letter from a high-school headmaster or teacher, including the recommender's email, phone number, and signature.
Submit a study plan in English or Chinese of at least 600 characters or words.
Submit the official Physical Examination Record for Foreigner, fully completed and valid for six months.
Submit a non-criminal record within its validity period.
Apply online from November 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026; this historical cycle is closed.
Pay the published non-refundable application fee: CNY 500 for self-sponsored applications or CNY 800 for scholarship applications.
Pay the published tuition for this route: CNY 22,000/academic year.
Published accommodation ranges from CNY 8,000 to CNY 19,000 per year and is arranged under the university's current annual policy.
